Because gamma governs the distribution of energy barriers for local structural rearrangements, it provides a quantitative, composition-resolved descriptor relevant to the intrinsic creep and thermal transport of C-S-H, linking nanoscale vibrational dynamics to the macroscopic durability of concrete. The dual-probe boson-peak approach is transferable to other amorphous solids, including the supplementary cementitious materials of low-carbon cements.

AI.tldr: 本文利用太赫兹时域光谱和低温量热法系统表征了硅酸钙水合物（C-S-H）中玻色峰（BP）随Ca/Si比（0.5-1.7）的变化规律，发现BP频率约1 THz，强度随Ca/Si比单调下降但峰值高度在Ca/Si=1.0处最大，揭示了硅链解聚与层间钙填充间的结构交叉，并提取了中程动力学关联长度（~1 nm）和弹性异质性参数γ（0.98降至0.48），为理解混凝土的蠕变和热传输提供了定量描述符。
AI.motivation: 玻色峰是无序固体中普遍存在的振动异常，但尚未在水泥水化主要产物C-S-H中得到系统表征，本研究旨在填补这一空白，建立C-S-H振动动力学与宏观耐久性之间的联系。
AI.method: 采用太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）和低温量热学两种探针对五种Ca/Si比（0.5-1.7）的C-S-H进行表征，结合Bruggeman校正消除晶体杂质影响，提取玻色峰特征参数及相干势弹性异质性参数γ。
AI.result: 两种方法均定位BP在~1 THz附近，频率一致但强度变化规律不同；太赫兹积分谱权重和量热Cp/T³峰值随Ca/Si比单调下降，但表观峰高在Ca/Si=1.0处最大；中程关联长度约0.3-2 nm，γ从0.98降至0.48，Debye归一化频率ν_BP/ν_D=0.15-0.17。
AI.conclusion: 玻色峰揭示的结构交叉和弹性异质性参数γ提供了与C-S-H内在蠕变和热传输相关的定量描述符，将纳米尺度振动动力学与混凝土宏观耐久性相关联；双探针方法可推广至其他非晶固体及低碳水泥辅助胶凝材料。

title: Pressure-Driven Structural Transitions without a Displacive Charge-Density Wave in La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$
summary: We investigated the structural properties of bilayer nickelate La$_2$SmNi$_2$O$_7$ as a function of pressure and temperature. At ambient conditions, we show that the material crystallizes as a monoclinic superstructure distinct from the one previously reported and close to the pseudo-orthorhombic structure of pristine La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. No signatures of satellite reflections associated with charge density wave (CDW) ordering are detected at low temperature. Upon compression, a sequence of pressure-induced structural transitions from monoclinic to orthorhombic 15 GPa and then tetragonal 21 GPa symmetry is observed. Within the superconducting dome, the quality of the X-ray diffraction data enables structural refinements enabling theoretical models to understand the emergence of superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了双层镍酸盐La₂SmNi₂O₇在高压和低温下的结构性质，发现其室温下为单斜超结构，随压力增加经历单斜→正交(15 GPa)→四方(21 GPa)的结构相变，且在低温下未检测到电荷密度波(CDW)序的信号。
AI.motivation: 探究双层镍酸盐La₂SmNi₂O₇在压力和温度变化下的结构演化规律，特别是其与超导电性出现的关系，为理解镍基超导机制提供结构基础。
AI.method: 利用X射线衍射(XRD)技术，在不同压力(环境压力至21 GPa以上)和低温条件下，对La₂SmNi₂O₇晶体结构进行精细化分析和结构精修。
AI.result: 1) 环境条件下La₂SmNi₂O₇为单斜超结构，不同于此前报道的结构；2) 低温下未发现电荷密度波(CDW)序的证据；3) 加压下出现单斜→正交(15 GPa)→四方(21 GPa)的结构相变序列；4) 在超导穹顶内获得了高质量XRD数据以支持结构精修。
AI.conclusion: 明确了La₂SmNi₂O₇的压力-温度结构相图，排除了CDW序在该体系低温下的存在，并为超导电性的理论模型提供了关键的结构约束条件。

title: Gyrotropy from Extrinsic Geometry in Twisted Materials
summary: Gyrotropy in twisted bilayer graphene can be used as a signature of interlayer electronic coherence. Gyrotropy can emerge in the absence of interlayer coupling in time-reversal symmetric bilayer systems. This gyrotropy originates from the extrinsic geometry associated with the physical geometry of the system and is independent of the structure of the electronic states. We first illustrate this effect for a purely classical bilayer array of one-dimensional wires. Next we study twisted bilayer graphene and show that the gyrotropy is entirely due to interlayer coherence. In doing so we observe that conductivities calculated in the Bistritzer-MacDonald frame differ significantly from conductivities measurable in the lab frame. Finally we consider twisted bilayer MoTe2, first as a pristine model where the gyrotropy exactly vanishes, and then with weak strain and displacement fields where we show that the geometric gyrotropy can dominate the coherent gyrotropy. Our results call attention to the necessity to separate the contribution of extrinsic physical geometry from the contribution of intrinsic electronic states to the properties of twisted materials.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了扭转双层材料中由物理几何（外在几何）导致的旋光性（gyrotropy），并强调必须将其与电子态内在结构相关的旋光性区分开来。研究发现，在无层间耦合时，时间反演对称的双层体系即可存在旋光性，其来源于系统的物理几何而非电子态结构。在扭转双层石墨烯中，旋光性完全源于层间相干性；而在扭转双层MoTe2中，几何旋光性可在弱应变和位移场下主导相干旋光性。
AI.motivation: 扭转双层材料中，旋光性常被用作层间电子相干的标志。然而，物理几何本身（非电子态结构）也能产生旋光性，这可能导致误判。因此需要分离外在几何与内在电子态的贡献。
AI.method: 先以一维经典双层线阵列为例说明几何旋光性；再研究扭转双层石墨烯的Bistritzer-MacDonald框架与实验室框架下电导率的差异；最后研究扭转双层MoTe2在理想情况、弱应变和位移场下的旋光性。
AI.result: 1) 经典双层线阵列中存在纯粹几何起源的旋光性；2) 扭转双层石墨烯中旋光性完全由层间相干性贡献；3) Bistritzer-MacDonald框架计算的电导率与实验室框架可测量的电导率存在显著差异；4) 理想扭转双层MoTe2中旋光性严格为零，但弱应变和位移场下几何旋光性可主导相干旋光性。
AI.conclusion: 必须仔细区分扭转材料中由外在物理几何和内在电子态结构分别贡献的旋光性，否则可能错误解读实验信号。

title: Derivation and application of a general scaling relation between the dc and asymptotic high-frequency optical Hall responses
summary: Based on the Kramers-Krong relations, we derive and apply a quite general expression that that relates the low frequency quasi-dc Hall conductivity to the asymptotic high frequency optical Hall response (and its manifestations in Kerr and Faraday effects) for time-reversal symmetry breaking (TRSB) states of matter like ferromagnets and time-reversal symmetry breaking superconductors as well as metals in magnetic field. Parametric plots shows this relation is obeyed exactly for the trivial single-mode case of sharp cyclotron resonance, and approximately for theoretical models for ferromagnets and TRSB superconductors. We also apply it to the experimental data from a variety of ferromagnetic systems and show reasonable agreement there as well. We use the relation to predict, from the size of the spontaneous Kerr effect at the pseudogap temperature of the cuprate superconductors that cuprates should exhibit an anomalous Hall effect of approximately 0.1 Ohm$^{-1}\cdot$cm$^{-1}$. This is a small value, but one within experimental reach and we encourage the search for it. Although not explicitly quantum geometric, our treatment has some similarities to efforts to set bounds on physical quantities based on quantum geometric relations and limited physical information.

AI.tldr: 基于Kramers-Kronig关系，本文推导了低频准直流霍尔电导率与高频光学霍尔响应之间的普适关系，并在铁磁体、超导体等系统中验证了这一关系，进而预测铜酸盐超导体在赝能隙温度下应存在约0.1 Ω⁻¹·cm⁻¹的反常霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: 建立时间反演对称性破缺系统中低频直流霍尔响应与高频光学霍尔响应之间的普适关系，从而可以利用更容易测量的光学Kerr/Faraday效应来推断难以直接测量的直流反常霍尔效应。
AI.method: 基于Kramers-Kronig色散关系，推导低频准直流霍尔电导率与高频光学霍尔响应（通过Kerr和Faraday效应表现）之间的数学关系。通过参数图在单模回旋共振情形下精确验证，并在铁磁体和TRSB超导体的理论模型中进行近似验证。
AI.result: 该关系在单模回旋共振情形下精确成立，在铁磁体和TRSB超导体的理论模型中近似成立，并在多个铁磁系统的实验数据中得到合理验证。利用该关系，预测铜酸盐超导体在赝能隙温度下应表现出约0.1 Ω⁻¹·cm⁻¹的反常霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立的K-K关系连接了低频与高频霍尔响应，为预测和探测时间反演对称性破缺系统中的反常霍尔效应提供了理论工具；铜酸盐超导体的预测值虽小但实验上可及，值得进一步实验探索；该方法与量子几何束缚有相似性，但本身不显式依赖量子几何。

title: Computing binary alloy phase diagrams with explicit configurational and vibrational entropy
summary: Phase stability in multicomponent solid solutions depends on configurational entropy beyond the ideal mixing limit, but capturing it together with vibrational entropy within the same atomistic framework remains challenging. Here, we extend non-equilibrium thermodynamic integration to composition-dependent transformations through an alchemical interpolation of the interactions, combined with Monte Carlo identity exchange moves and molecular dynamics that sample the vibrational and non-ideal configurational entropy along the integration path. We apply the framework to the Au-Cu binary alloy using Atomic Cluster Expansion potentials trained on density functional theory data using the LDA, PBE, and r2SCAN functionals, and construct composition-temperature phase diagrams directly from atomistic free energies. We find that explicit configurational sampling lowers the AuCu order-disorder transition temperature predicted by the ACE potential trained on LDA data from approximately 810 K to 710 K, closer to the experimental value of 683 K, and substantially widens the stability range of the solid solution. At the same time, the much larger sensitivity to the exchange-correlation functional shows that this level of agreement should not be interpreted as general predictive accuracy. Non-ideal configurational entropy must therefore be sampled explicitly, alongside a careful choice of functional, for a reliable atomistic description of binary phase diagrams.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合非平衡热力学积分与蒙特卡洛身份交换、分子动力学的方法，通过炼金插值处理成分依赖的相变，直接在原子尺度构建Au-Cu二元合金的相图。研究发现，显式构型熵采样降低了AuCu有序-无序转变温度，使其更接近实验值，但交换关联泛函的选择对结果影响更大。
AI.motivation: 多组分固溶体的相稳定性取决于超出理想混合极限的构型熵，但将构型熵与振动熵在同一原子框架中同时捕捉仍具有挑战性。
AI.method: 扩展非平衡热力学积分到成分依赖相变，通过炼金插值交互作用，结合蒙特卡洛身份交换和分子动力学，沿积分路径采样振动熵和非理想构型熵。使用基于LDA、PBE、r2SCAN泛函训练的原子团簇展开势，对Au-Cu二元合金进行原子尺度自由能计算并构建相图。
AI.result: 显式构型采样使ACE势（LDA数据训练）预测的AuCu有序-无序转变温度从约810K降至710K，更接近实验值683K，并显著拓宽了固溶体的稳定范围。但交换关联泛函的敏感性远大于此，表明不应将这种一致性解读为普遍预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 非理想构型熵必须显式采样，同时需谨慎选择交换关联泛函，才能可靠地描述二元相图。

title: Long-range and steady-state entanglement of driven-dissipative nitrogen vacancy centers using microwaves as a drive and synthetic antiferromagnet as a dissipator
summary: The search for optimal schemes and dissipative environments for mediating long-range entanglement between two distant nitrogen-vacancy centers (NVCs) in diamond is the subject of ongoing vigorous efforts due to potential applications of such microscopic solid-state qubits in quantum sensing and quantum computing. However, stabilizing entanglement of NVCs into steady-state poses a significant challenge, typically requiring tuning the environment into a {\em nonequilibrium} state. Here we microscopically derive a Lindblad quantum master equation for a system of two driven-dissipative NVCs, where the drive is microwave radiation and dissipation is provided by a single magnetic bath that is kept in {\em equilibrium}. This equation allows us to predict precise conditions for long-range and steady-state entanglement of NVCs, while it also suggests synthetic antiferromagnet as an optimal choice for a dissipative environment. By using realistic parameters from available experiments, we estimate steady-state concurrence reaching $\mathcal{C}\simeq 0.28$ for two NVCs separated by $\sim 100 \: \mathrm{nm}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在平衡磁浴环境中通过微波驱动实现两个相距约100纳米的氮空位中心稳态纠缠的方案，理论估计稳态纠缠度可达约0.28。
AI.motivation: 寻找在固态微观量子比特（如钻石中的氮空位中心）之间实现长程纠缠的最优方案和耗散环境，对于量子传感和量子计算应用至关重要，但现有方法通常需要将环境调至非平衡态，面临稳定性挑战。
AI.method: 微观推导出一个用于两个驱动-耗散NVC系统的Lindblad量子主方程，其中驱动源为微波辐射，耗散由保持平衡态的单磁浴提供，并识别出合成反铁磁体为最优耗散环境。
AI.result: 基于实验可用参数，理论估计两个相距约100纳米的NVC可实现稳态纠缠度（concurrence）达到约0.28。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在平衡环境中实现固态量子比特的长程稳态纠缠提供了精确条件，并指出合成反铁磁体作为耗散环境的最优选择，具有实验可行性。

title: Fast two-dimensional tensor-network contraction via subspace iteration
summary: The corner transfer matrix renormalization group (CTMRG) is one of the standard contraction methods for infinite projected entangled-pair states (iPEPS), but its computational cost is dominated by repeated truncated singular value decompositions (SVDs). We introduce subspace-iteration CTMRG (SI-CTMRG), a QR-based projector construction that replaces each large-matrix SVD with an SVD of a much smaller matrix. The resulting algorithm shifts the dominant cost from decompositions to tensor contractions, making it highly suited to GPU acceleration and yielding speedups of up to two orders of magnitude over standard CTMRG. We demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of the method for the triangular-lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet, reaching state-of-the-art iPEPS results on a single H100 GPU in approximately 10 hours of computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SI-CTMRG方法，用QR分解和子空间迭代替代传统CTMRG中的大规模SVD，将计算瓶颈从矩阵分解转移到张量收缩，在GPU上实现高达两个数量级的加速，并在三角晶格海森堡反铁磁模型上取得了最先进的iPEPS结果。
AI.motivation: 传统CTMRG方法的计算成本主要来自重复的截断奇异值分解（SVD），这些大规模SVD计算效率低下，难以充分利用GPU加速能力，限制了iPEPS在大规模量子多体问题中的应用。
AI.method: 提出基于QR分解的子空间迭代CTMRG（SI-CTMRG），通过QR-based投影器构建，将原本需要在大矩阵上执行的SVD替换为对更小矩阵的SVD，从而将主导计算成本从矩阵分解转移到张量收缩操作上。
AI.result: 相比标准CTMRG，SI-CTMRG实现了高达两个数量级的加速；在单个H100 GPU上，仅用约10小时即可获得三角晶格海森堡反铁磁模型的最先进iPEPS结果。
AI.conclusion: SI-CTMRG通过QR子空间迭代策略有效规避了大规模SVD的计算瓶颈，显著提升了CTMRG的GPU适配性和运行效率，为iPEPS在复杂量子多体系统中的应用提供了高效可行的计算方案。

title: Recent progress on liquid transport growth of quantum materials
summary: Liquid transport growth (LTG) is a horizontal flux growth technique that is closely analogous to chemical vapor transport, with the key distinction that a molten flux rather than a vapor serves as the transport agent. Unlike conventional flux growth, LTG spatially separates charge dissolution and crystal precipitation and couples them through continuous solute transport under a deliberately imposed temperature gradient. This enables crystal growth to begin before the charge is completely dissolved, removes the equilibrium solubility constraint on the starting charge/flux ratio, and allows large yields of single crystals to be obtained from a single growth. Recent studies have further shown that by spatially separating dissolution and crystallization and maintaining crystallization at a nearly constant temperature, LTG is particularly effective for two classes of materials: compounds that crystallize only within a narrow temperature and/or composition window, and compounds whose stoichiometry, defect concentration, and thus physical properties are sensitive to the crystallization temperature. In this review, we discuss representative examples including Fe$_3$Sn$_2$, CrTe$_3$, YFe$_2$Ge$_2$, UTe$_2$, CeRh$_2$As$_2$, MoTe$_2$, WTe$_2$, and LuNb$_6$Sn$_6$ to illustrate the unique capabilities of LTG for producing high quality single crystals of diverse quantum materials. We also summarize practical considerations for LTG experimental design, including furnace selection, growth time, melt stability, and ampoule geometry, and discuss future opportunities for transforming LTG from an empirical growth method into a more predictive crystal growth technique.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了液相输运生长（LTG）技术——一种利用熔融助熔剂而非蒸汽作为输运介质的水平通量生长方法。LTG通过空间分离溶解与结晶过程，在温度梯度驱动下实现连续溶质输运，突破了传统助熔剂生长的热力学限制，特别适用于窄温区结晶及对结晶温度敏感的材料。文章以Fe₃Sn₂、UTe₂等多种量子材料为例展示了LTG的优势，并讨论了实验设计与未来发展方向。
AI.motivation: 传统助熔剂生长方法存在溶解度平衡限制、起始原料/助熔剂比例受约束、晶体产量低等问题，且难以生长仅在窄温度/成分窗口内结晶或物性对结晶温度敏感的材料。LTG技术通过空间分离溶解与结晶，有望克服这些局限性。
AI.method: LTG是一种水平通量生长技术，其核心思想是：将电荷溶解与晶体析出在空间上分离，通过施加温度梯度驱动熔融助熔剂中的溶质持续输运，使晶体生长可在电荷完全溶解前开始，从而摆脱传统助熔剂法的平衡溶解度约束。
AI.result: LTG能够从单次生长中获得大量单晶，尤其适用于两类材料：(1) 仅在窄温/成分窗口内结晶的化合物；(2) 化学计量比、缺陷浓度及物理性质对结晶温度敏感的化合物。Fe₃Sn₂、CrTe₃、YFe₂Ge₂、UTe₂、CeRh₂As₂、MoTe₂、WTe₂、LuNb₆Sn₆等量子材料的高质量单晶生长验证了该技术的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LTG是一种有潜力的晶体生长技术，能够在传统方法受限的条件下生长高质量量子材料单晶。未来发展方向包括：将LTG从经验性方法转变为更具预测性的晶体生长技术，需要进一步优化炉体选择、生长时间、熔体稳定性、安瓿几何形状等实验参数。

title: Driven-dissipative superconductivity in moiré heterostructure without attraction
summary: Dissipative preparation of quantum order offers a route to superconductivity that does not rely on enhancing attractive interactions. Here we propose a driven-dissipative protocol to prepare superconductivity as a stationary state of a two-dimensional moiré heterostructure. The key ingredient is a bilayer moiré platform in which the layer degree of freedom acts as a pseudospin, allowing the pseudospin structure required for pairing to be implemented through optically induced spatial operations. This preparation scheme requires local dissipation, which we show to arises naturally from weakly dispersive bosonic modes in the heterostructure. In contrast, in the opposite regime of collective dissipation, the same platform exhibits an early-time superradiant burst. Our results establish driven-dissipative moiré heterostructures as a promising platform for preparing superconductivity, while also revealing a connection between steady-state pairing and transient superradiance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在二维莫尔异质结中通过驱动-耗散协议制备超导态的方法，利用层自由度作为赝自旋，通过光学诱导空间操作实现配对所需的赝自旋结构，并发现局域耗散自然产生于弱色散玻色子模，而集体耗散则导致早期超辐射爆发。
AI.motivation: 传统超导制备依赖增强吸引相互作用，而本文探索一种不依赖吸引相互作用的耗散制备量子有序的新途径，以实现超导态。
AI.method: 采用双层莫尔平台，将层自由度作为赝自旋，通过光诱导空间操作实现配对所需赝自旋结构，并利用局域耗散（来自弱色散玻色子模）实现驱动-耗散协议，制备超导稳态。
AI.result: 局域耗散可自然实现超导稳态制备；在集体耗散相反区域，平台表现出早期超辐射爆发；建立了稳态配对与瞬态超辐射之间的联系。
AI.conclusion: 驱动-耗散莫尔异质结是制备超导态的有前景平台，并揭示了稳态超导与瞬态超辐射之间的内在关联。

title: Are we facing a reproducibility crises in materials synthesis? A systematic review of Turkevich AuNP synthesis and CVD MoS2 growth
summary: Reproducibility remains a major challenge in materials synthesis, particularly for nanomaterials whose properties are highly sensitive to experimental conditions. Here, we present a systematic review and meta-analysis evaluating the reproducibility of two widely used synthesis routes: the Turkevich method for gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) and the chemical vapor deposition (CVD) growth of MoS2. An adapted PRISMA-based protocol combined with a modified SPIDER framework was applied to assess methodological transparency, parameter reporting, and experimental consistency across the literature. More than 1,300 articles for each case study were retrieved from Scopus and Web of Science and systematically screened using structured checklists and a Python-based text classification algorithm validated against independent human reviewers. Despite the extensive literature and the widespread perception of these methods as reproducible, only a small fraction of studies rigorously addressed synthesis reproducibility. Critical experimental parameters were frequently underreported, and statistical analyses were rarely included, limiting inter-laboratory comparability and reproducibility. These findings demonstrate the value of systematic reviews and meta-analyses as tools for identifying reproducibility gaps and guiding the development of more transparent and reliable synthesis protocols in materials science.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了金纳米颗粒Turkevich法和MoS2的CVD生长两种合成方法的可重复性。通过PRISMA+SPIDER框架筛选了1300多篇文章，发现尽管文献众多，但关键参数报告不足、统计分析缺失，导致可重复性严重受限。
AI.motivation: 纳米材料合成领域可重复性差，特别是两种广泛使用的方法（Turkevich法合成AuNPs和CVD生长MoS2）缺乏系统的可重复性评估，作者希望识别其中的复现性差距。
AI.method: 采用改良的PRISMA协议和SPIDER框架，从Scopus和Web of Science检索1300多篇文章，使用结构化检查表和Python文本分类算法（经人类评审验证）进行系统筛选。
AI.result: 尽管文献量庞大且被认为高度可重复，但仅少数研究严格处理了合成可重复性问题；关键实验参数经常报告不足，统计分析极少包含，限制了实验室间可比性和可重复性。
AI.conclusion: 系统综述和元分析是识别可重复性差距的有效工具，可指导材料科学领域开发更透明、更可靠的合成协议。

title: Fermiology of the kagome compound LuNb6Sn6 probed by de Haas-van Alphen oscillations
summary: We report a detailed de Haas-van Alphen (dHvA) study of the recently discovered kagome metal LuNb6Sn6 using torque magnetometry, magnetization, and heat-capacity measurements. Temperature-dependent torque and heat-capacity data reveal a charge density wave (CDW) transition at T_CDW = 85 K. The thermal hysteresis observed in both measurements establishes the first-order nature of the transition. Quantum oscillation measurements identify two major dHvA frequencies: F_alpha ~ 20 T and F_beta ~ 200 T, and their angular dependence is consistent with ellipsoidal Fermi surface (FS) pockets. Landau fan diagram analysis reveals evidence for a nontrivial Berry phase associated with the F_alpha pocket, indicating possible nontrivial electronic topology in LuNb6Sn6. Analysis of the temperature and magnetic field dependence of the oscillations using the Lifshitz-Kosevich formula yields electronic parameters that indicate anisotropic quantum transport properties. First-principles calculations provide further insight into the electronic structure, revealing Dirac-like band crossings, a flat band, and multiple van Hove singularities near the Fermi level. Our calculations based on the pristine phase cannot fully reproduce the experimentally observed quantum oscillation frequencies, suggesting that CDW-induced FS reconstruction plays a crucial role in the ground-state electronic structure of LuNb6Sn6. These results provide new insight into the FS topology and electronic structure of LuNb6Sn6, enriching our understanding of the electronic properties of kagome materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过dHvA效应、磁化率和热容测量，研究了kagome金属LuNb6Sn6的电子结构，发现85 K处的电荷密度波相变（一级相变）、两个主要量子振荡频率（F_α ~ 20 T和F_β ~ 200 T）、F_α口袋的非平庸Berry相，以及CDW导致的费米面重构。
AI.motivation: 探究新发现的kagome金属LuNb6Sn6的费米面拓扑和电子结构，特别是电荷密度波（CDW）对电子结构的重构作用，以及可能存在的非平庸电子拓扑特性。
AI.method: 采用扭矩磁强法、磁化率测量和热容测量，结合dHvA量子振荡分析（Lifshitz-Kosevich公式、Landau扇图分析）以及第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 发现T_CDW=85 K的一级CDW相变；识别出两个主要dHvA频率F_α~20 T和F_β~200 T，对应椭球状费米面；F_α口袋具有非平庸Berry相；电子参数显示各向异性量子输运特性；第一性原理计算显示Dirac-like能带交叉、平带和多个van Hove奇点，但无法完全复现实验观测的振荡频率，表明CDW诱导的费米面重构至关重要。
AI.conclusion: LuNb6Sn6中存在CDW诱导的费米面重构，且F_α口袋具有非平庸电子拓扑性质，这些发现丰富了对kagome材料电子性质的理解。

title: Spot Profile Analysis Low Energy Electron Diffraction of Plasma-Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition Grown Epitaxial Few-Layer Graphene on Sapphire
comment: The following article has been submitted to Applied Physics Letters
summary: We demonstrate the use of high-resolution spot-profile analysis low-energy electron diffraction to determine the mean grain size of plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition grown few-layer graphene on sapphire (Al$_2$O$_3$). The diffraction patterns exhibit broadened graphene spots, pronounced diffuse scattering, and azimuthally extended features, indicating finite crystallite size and rotational disorder. By analyzing the finite-size broadening of the specular (00) spot with an Airy-type diffraction profile, we determine a mean grain diameter of 3.7$\,$nm for the as-grown graphene layer. Post-growth annealing under ultrahigh-vacuum conditions increases the mean grain size to about 5.7$\,$nm and 6.8$\,$nm, respectively. These results establish SPA-LEED as a sensitive reciprocal-space method for quantifying the structural coherence of directly grown graphene on insulating substrates.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高分辨率SPA-LEED技术测量了蓝宝石衬底上PECVD生长的少层石墨烯的平均晶粒尺寸，发现原始样品为3.7 nm，退火后增大至5.7-6.8 nm，证明了该方法对绝缘衬底上石墨烯结构相干性表征的适用性。
AI.motivation: 需要一种灵敏的倒空间方法，用于定量表征直接在绝缘衬底（如蓝宝石）上生长的石墨烯的结构相干性（晶粒尺寸和取向有序性）。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率SPA-LEED技术获取衍射花样，通过Airy型衍射轮廓分析镜面(00)斑点的有限展宽，从而定量确定平均晶粒直径。
AI.result: 原始PECVD生长石墨烯的平均晶粒直径为3.7 nm；UHV退火后分别增大至约5.7 nm和6.8 nm。衍射花样呈现斑点展宽、漫散射和方位角延伸特征，表明有限晶粒尺寸和旋转无序。
AI.conclusion: SPA-LEED是一种灵敏的倒空间方法，可用于直接生长在绝缘衬底上的石墨烯的结构相干性定量表征。

title: Single-component twisted $\mathbb{Z}_3$ orthogonal metal in an $e/3$-anyon fluid
summary: We propose an unconventional metallic phase emerging on doping the $1/3$ Fractional Chern insulator, which can serve as a parent state to anyon superconductivity with arbitrary chiral central charge. It is a twisted $\mathbb{Z}_3$ orthogonal metal: a state with vanishing electron quasiparticle weight but a single well-defined Fermi surface of emergent charge-$e/3$ fermions coupled to a Dijkgraaf-Witten twisted $\mathbb{Z}_3$ gauge field. It is manifestly valley-symmetric and valley-gapped. Pairing this fractionalized Fermi surface then removes the topological order and produces a family of superconductors whose chiral central charge is directly set by the BdG band topology of the paired $e/3$ fermions, while the angular momentum of the physical order parameter is constrained to be a multiple of three. This scenario provides a route to superconducting states beyond anyon-superconductivity constructions based on $2e/3$ anyons. The metallic phase itself carries distinctive ``fractional Fermiology'' signatures: $e/3$ shot noise, anomalous quantum oscillations, and a $6π$ ac Josephson effect when it mediates the Josephson coupling between superconductors. We construct explicit wavefunction ansatz realizing the phase, and argue that inter-valley repulsion between anyons stabilizes this phase compared to competing states. We show that the construction extends to higher Laughlin states but not to Jain states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种掺杂1/3分数量子陈绝缘体后出现的非常规金属相——扭曲Z3正交金属，该相可作为任意子超导的母态，通过配对分数化费米面产生具有任意手征中心荷的超导体，并表现出e/3散粒噪声、反常量子振荡和6π交流约瑟夫森效应等分数费米学特征。
AI.motivation: 探索掺杂分数量子陈绝缘体后的非常规金属相及其作为任意子超导母态的可行性，构建超越传统2e/3任意子超导方案的超导态构造路径。
AI.method: 提出扭曲Z3正交金属相的理论框架，包含电荷e/3费米子与Dijkgraaf-Witten扭曲Z3规范场的耦合；构建显式波函数ansatz；分析能谷间排斥作用对相的稳定性；推广到更高Laughlin态。

title: Growth-controlled suppression of electrically active defects in CrSBr
comment: main: 11 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables; SI: 19 pages, 14 figures
summary: In CrSBr, as in many crystalline materials, the type and density of defects are expected to strongly influence material behavior. Identifying the underlying atomic defect configurations and controlling their populations during growth are therefore important steps toward understanding and ultimately tailoring its rich magneto-electrical properties. However, systematic control of defects in CrSBr during chemical vapor transport (CVT) growth has not yet been established. Here, we correlate CVT growth conditions with defect concentrations measured using conductive atomic force microscopy (CAFM). We focus on a characteristic defect with a strong electronic fingerprint, labeled D*, and decrease its concentration by up to an order of magnitude through optimized growth conditions. We show that defect densities can be tuned by adjusting precursor stoichiometry, where sulfur- and bromine-rich conditions suppress defect formation, and by lowering the absolute growth temperatures while maintaining the same temperature gradient. Thermodynamic modeling and density functional theory calculations suggest that D* is most consistent with a sulfur-related vacancy complex rather than an isolated point defect. These results provide practical strategies for growing high-quality CrSBr with controlled defect densities.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过优化化学气相输运生长条件，将CrSBr中特征缺陷D*的浓度降低了一个数量级，并揭示了该缺陷最可能源于硫相关空位复合体。
AI.motivation: CrSBr的缺陷类型和密度强烈影响其磁电性能，但系统控制CVT生长中的缺陷尚未实现，因此需要建立生长条件与缺陷浓度之间的关联。
AI.method: 使用导电原子力显微镜（CAFM）表征缺陷浓度，结合热力学建模和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，通过调节前驱体化学计量比和生长温度来优化生长条件。
AI.result: 硫和溴丰富的条件以及降低绝对生长温度可有效抑制D*缺陷，缺陷浓度最多可降低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: D*缺陷最可能为硫相关空位复合体而非孤立点缺陷，该工作为生长高质量、可控缺陷密度的CrSBr提供了实用策略。

title: Synergistic Effects of Phosphorus Doping and Oxygen Vacancies on Formaldehyde Oxidation over CeO$_2$(111): A First Principles Investigation
summary: Using a combination of static and dynamic density functional theory simulations, we systematically investigated how phosphorus doping and oxygen vacancies on the CeO$_2$(111) surface influence the oxidation mechanisms of formaldehyde (HCHO). Our results reveal that P cations (P$^{5+}$) substitutionally replace Ce$^{4+}$ in the lattice, forming Ce$-$O$-$P bonds that reduce the band gap (from 2.26 eV to 2.09 eV) and generate localized Ce$^{3+}$ states through charge redistribution. This synergistic effect of P doping combined with oxygen vacancy strengthens HCHO adsorption by decreasing the adsorption energy from -0.62 eV on pristine CeO$_2$(111) to -2.65 eV on the defective P-doped surface. Importantly, P doping lowers the C$-$H bond cleavage barrier by 0.84 eV relative to pristine CeO$_2$(111), accelerating formaldehyde oxidation on the defective surface. In addition, the rapid desorption of CO$_2$ and H$_2$O ($τ\sim 0.59 s$ at 300 K) indicates weak product-surface interactions, which favor efficient catalyst regeneration during continuous operation. These findings highlight P-doped CeO$_2$(111) as a promising system for low-temperature HCHO oxidation and provide insights into the design of ceria-based catalytic materials.

AI.tldr: 通过静态和动态密度泛函理论模拟，系统研究了磷掺杂和氧空位对CeO₂(111)表面甲醛氧化机制的影响。P掺杂降低带隙、生成Ce³⁺态，与氧空位协同增强HCHO吸附，降低C-H键断裂能垒0.84 eV，促进产物快速脱附，为低温HCHO氧化提供了有前景的催化体系。
AI.motivation: 探索磷掺杂和氧空位对CeO₂(111)表面甲醛氧化机制的影响，以设计更高效的低温HCHO氧化催化剂。
AI.method: 采用静态和动态密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟，系统研究P掺杂与氧空位对CeO₂(111)表面结构、电子性质及HCHO氧化反应路径的影响。
AI.result: 1) P⁵⁺取代Ce⁴⁺形成Ce-O-P键，带隙从2.26 eV降至2.09 eV，并产生局域Ce³⁺态；2) P掺杂+氧空位协同将HCHO吸附能从-0.62 eV降至-2.65 eV；3) C-H键断裂能垒降低0.84 eV；4) CO₂和H₂O在300 K下快速脱附（τ~0.59 s）。
AI.conclusion: P掺杂CeO₂(111)是一种有前景的低温HCHO氧化催化体系，为设计基于氧化铈的催化材料提供了重要见解。

title: Scalable Fabrication of Diamond-on-Silica Heterostructures via High-Selectivity Deep ICP-RIE and Room-Temperature Bonding
summary: Single-crystal diamond is a leading material platform for high-power electronics and solid-state quantum technologies, yet many device architectures require micrometer-scale membranes with deeply etched features, patterned from commercially available substrates. In this work, we demonstrate a complete through-etch of a 16 μm -thick NV-doped single-crystal diamond membrane using a single-layer SiO2 hard mask combined with a multi-step oxygen-based ICPRIE process. With a diamond-to-SiO2 selectivity of 15:1, this non-metallic mask strategy can achieve etch depths of few tens of μm with well-defined sidewalls, conserved surface roughness and negligible micromasking. Furthermore, we use the oxide layer that remains after etching to serve as the bonding surface in a subsequent integration step. The etched microstructures are transferred onto SiO2 substrates and bonded at room temperature using O2 plasma surface activation and a sodium silicate interlayer. The resulting siloxane film is optically transparent across the visible spectrum and introduces no detectable parasitic photoluminescence, preserving the optical readout of the embedded NV centers. Together, this deep-etch and room-temperature bonding process provides a scalable and contaminationfree route from bulk diamond membranes to diamond-on-silica heterostructures for integrated quantum photonics and sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种在16μm厚的NV掺杂单晶金刚石膜上实现完全贯穿刻蚀的方法，采用单层SiO2硬掩模结合多步氧基ICP-RIE工艺，达到15:1的选择比，并利用刻蚀后剩余的氧化物层在室温下与SiO2基底键合，形成金刚石-二氧化硅异质结构，适用于集成量子和传感应用。
AI.motivation: 金刚石是高性能电子学和量子技术的重要材料平台，但许多器件结构需要具有深刻蚀特征的微米级薄膜，而现有工艺难以兼顾刻蚀深度、侧壁质量、表面粗糙度和无金属污染，亟需一种可扩展、无污染的方法。
AI.method: 采用单层SiO2硬掩模（非金属掩模），结合多步氧基ICP-RIE工艺，实现16μm厚金刚石膜的完全贯穿刻蚀（金刚石:SiO2选择比15:1）；刻蚀后剩余的氧化物层作为键合界面，通过O2等离子体表面激活和硅酸钠中间层在室温下与SiO2基底键合。
AI.result: 实现了数十微米深度的刻蚀，侧壁轮廓清晰，表面粗糙度保持良好，无微掩蔽效应；键合后的硅氧烷膜在可见光波段光学透明，无寄生光致发光，可保持NV中心的光学读出性能。
AI.conclusion: 该深刻蚀与室温键合组合工艺提供了一条从体金刚石膜到金刚石-二氧化硅异质结构的可扩展、无污染路线，适用于集成量子光子学和传感应用。

title: Modeling the Fatigue Behavior of Amorphous Polymers
summary: Prediction of material durability is both very important and very difficult. In many cases, material durability is measured by subjecting a sample to repeating oscillatory cycles (in shear or tension-compression) until it fails in either ductile or brittle fashion. Typically, the stress amplitude is denoted S, and the number of cycles N, so the resulting dependence is known as the SN-curve. For many materials, SN curve has been shown to obey the empirical Basquin's law, N = AS^(-m), where the prefactor A was a function of the temperature, load frequency, and sample history, and the power law m was a real number, usually between 3 and 12. Here, we derive the Basquin's law using a linearized version of the Long's plasticity model and demonstrate that within this framework, m = 3. We also derive the expression for the prefactor A. Finally, we show that our theory successfully describes experimental data for three amorphous polymers, PS, PMMA, and PVC.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Long塑性模型的线性化版本推导了Basquin定律（N = A S^(-m)），并证明该模型中m=3，同时给出了系数A的表达式。该理论成功描述了三种非晶聚合物（PS、PMMA、PVC）的疲劳实验数据。
AI.motivation: 材料耐久性预测非常重要但困难，而经验性Basquin定律中的参数（特别是幂律指数m和前置因子A）缺乏从物理机制出发的理论推导，作者希望建立更坚实的理论框架来解释SN曲线。
AI.method: 采用Long塑性模型的线性化版本，通过数学推导得到Basquin定律的形式，并确定幂律指数m=3以及前置因子A的显式表达式。
AI.result: 理论推导得出m=3，并给出了A的表达式；该理论在三种非晶聚合物（PS、PMMA、PVC）的实验数据上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: Long塑性模型的线性化版本能够从理论上推导出Basquin定律，且m=3具有普适性；该模型能很好地描述非晶聚合物的疲劳行为。

title: Ridge-Spin-Layer Coupling and Emergent Ridgetronics in 2D Altermagnets
summary: Extending valleytronics from discrete points to continuous lines in momentum space transforms dispersionless bands into a controllable degree of freedom. Here we introduce ridge--spin--layer coupling (RSLC) in two-dimensional (2D) altermagnets, where a one-dimensional continuous line of dispersionless electronic states (a ridge) in momentum space locks to both spin polarization and atomic sublayer. This ridge-induced quenching of kinetic energy mimics flat-band physics, yet crucially, RSLC grants external control, allowing for layer-selective switching of ridge orientation in reciprocal space, spin-filtered transport in real space, and a distinct electric Hall response. Guided by collinear spin layer group symmetry, we identify three 2D candidate materials, namely Mg$_2$Mo$_2$(PO$_5$)$_2$, Ca(FeP)$_2$, and Mg$_2$V$_2$(SO$_5$)$_2$, each featuring a crossed-ridge structure with two ridges, one per spin channel and sublayer. Our work establishes ridgetronics as a controllable platform for direction-discriminating currents, bridging dispersionless bands with multifunctional device operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"脊-自旋-层耦合"(RSLC)概念，在二维交变磁体中实现动量空间连续线上的色散消失态（脊），该脊同时锁定自旋极化和原子子层。通过层选择可切换脊取向，实现自旋过滤输运和电霍尔响应，并识别出三种候选材料：Mg₂Mo₂(PO₅)₂、Ca(FeP)₂和Mg₂V₂(SO₅)₂。
AI.motivation: 将谷电子学从动量空间离散点扩展到连续线，使无色散能带成为可控自由度，从而为方向选择电流和多功能器件提供新平台。
AI.method: 基于共线自旋层群对称性，提出RSLC机制。在二维交变磁体中，动量空间一维连续无色散电子态（脊）同时锁定自旋极化和原子子层，并通过层选择实现脊取向的切换控制。
AI.result: 识别出三种候选材料：Mg₂Mo₂(PO₅)₂、Ca(FeP)₂和Mg₂V₂(SO₅)₂，均具有交叉脊结构（每个自旋通道和子层各有一条脊）。实现了层选择性脊取向切换、自旋过滤输运和独特的电霍尔响应。
AI.conclusion: 建立了"脊电子学"(ridgetronics)这一可控平台，将无色散能带与多功能器件操作桥接起来，为方向判别电流和自旋电子学应用提供新范式。

title: Local magnetic correlations and light-sensitive centers in the Cr2AlC MAX phase
summary: Cr2AlC MAX phase is synthesized by high-pressure solid-state annealing and investigated as a candidate platform for optically responsive magnetism. Structural characterization confirms the formation of the Cr2AlC phase, while magnetic and optical-magnetic properties are examined by superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) magnetometry, electron spin resonance (ESR), and first principles calculations. SQUID magnetometry identifies Cr 2AlC as a weak, field-linear metallic paramagnet dominated by Pauli-like susceptibility of itinerant Cr-derived states. Its non-monotonic temperature dependence is described by an additional contribution from antiferromagnetically coupled Cr-Cr dimers, whereas the low-temperature Curie-like upturn originates from only a trace population of localized Cr centers. Under red-light illumination, SQUID magnetometry does not reveal an intrinsic macroscopic optomagnetic response. In contrast, ESR at 4 K shows a reversible light-induced reduction of a local magnetic signal, but the optically modified spin population corresponds only to several tens of ppm of the Cr sublattice. Ab initio Bethe-Salpeter equation (ai-BSE) calculations combined with the maximally localized Wannier function analysis suggest that optical excitation can redistribute spin polarization between neighboring Cr sites with the opposite local moments. The combined experiment-theory approach therefore establishes the hierarchy of magnetic contributions in Cr 2AlC and identifies the microscopic origin of its local optical sensitivity. This provides a reference for designing MAX phases and related MXenes in which defects, surface terminations or reduced dimensionality may enhance optically active magnetic states.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高压固相退火合成Cr₂AlC MAX相，结合SQUID、ESR和第一性原理计算，揭示了其弱顺磁、局部光磁响应的微观机制，为设计光活性MAX相及MXene提供了参考。
AI.motivation: 探索Cr₂AlC MAX相作为光学响应磁性材料平台的可行性，并建立其磁性贡献的层次结构及局部光敏感性的微观起源。
AI.method: 高压固相退火合成、SQUID磁强计、电子自旋共振（ESR）、第一性原理计算（ai-BSE + Wannier函数分析）。
AI.result: Cr₂AlC为弱顺磁金属，Pauli顺磁占主导；红光照射下SQUID未观察到宏观光磁响应，但ESR显示4K下可逆光致局部磁信号减小（仅几十ppm）；计算表明光激发可在相邻Cr位点间重新分布自旋极化。
AI.conclusion: 实验与理论结合明确了Cr₂AlC中磁性贡献的层级，找到了局部光学敏感性的微观起源，为设计具有增强光活性磁性态的MAX相和MXene提供了参考。

title: Emergent d-wave altermagnetism in chlorine-adsorbed FeSe monolayer
summary: The recent emergence of altermagnetism has opened new frontiers in condensed matter physics, yet material platforms capable of hosting both intrinsic altermagnetic order and superconductivity remain exceedingly rare. Here, based on symmetry analysis and first-principles calculations, we propose a realistic route to engineer robust altermagnetism in monolayer FeSe, a prototypical iron-based superconductor. By designing a stoichiometric Fe2Se2Cl structure through single-side Cl adsorption and introducing gate-tunable hole doping, we achieve a highly stable altermagnetic ground state. Our calculations reveal a synergistic mechanism: hole doping firmly stabilizes the checkerboard magnetic order, while the asymmetric ligand environment intrinsically breaks the outof-plane spatial inversion symmetry. Consequently, this interplay induces a giant altermagnetic spin splitting of up to 620 meV. Crucially, we demonstrate that this altermagnetic state and its giant spin splitting are highly resilient, persisting even in a 10-layer slab model that accurately simulates the bulk limit. By introducing altermagnetism into the well-established FeSe-based superconducting family, our findings identify Fe2Se2Cl as a promising platform for spintronic applications and motivate future studies of the possible interplay between altermagnetism and superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在单层FeSe中通过单侧Cl吸附和栅极调控空穴掺杂，实现稳定的交变磁序，并观测到高达620 meV的巨大自旋劈裂，为FeSe基超导家族引入交变磁性提供了实验可行的平台。
AI.motivation: 交变磁性与超导电性共存的材料平台极为稀缺，亟需寻找兼具本征交变磁序和超导特性的候选体系。
AI.method: 基于对称性分析和第一性原理计算，设计Fe2Se2Cl化学计量结构（单侧Cl吸附），结合栅极调控空穴掺杂，并通过多层平板模型验证其体相极限下的稳定性。
AI.result: 实现了高达620 meV的交变磁自旋劈裂，并在10层平板模型中仍保持高度鲁棒性；空穴掺杂可牢固稳定棋盘磁序，非对称配体环境破缺面外空间反演对称性。
AI.conclusion: Fe2Se2Cl作为兼具交变磁性与超导性的候选平台，为自旋电子学应用及交变磁-超导相互作用研究奠定了材料基础。

title: Hyperfine driven spin relaxation of charge carriers in metal-halide perovskites
summary: Spin relaxation of localized charge carriers in semiconductors is primarily governed by hyperfine interaction with the surrounding nuclear spin bath. While this mechanism is well-established in III-V bulk materials and quantum dots, its critical role in metal halide perovskites (MHPs) has only recently emerged. Their inverted band structure induces an unusual hierarchy of hyperfine couplings, with hole interactions dominating electron interactions, particurlaly in Pb-based perovskites. Here, we adapt a spin relaxation model - originally developed for muon spin spectroscopy - to provide an exact description of longitudinal spin relaxation for localized carriers across arbitrary hyperfine correlation times. This approach is motivated by recent experimental evidence in MAPbI3, which places carrier spins in an intermediate correlation regime, where conventional mono-exponential approximations fail. Our analysis reveals distinct hyperfine relaxation channels: electrons couple primarily to halogen nuclei, whereas holes are governed by metal nuclei. This leads to a key prediction - perovskites with lighter halogens and metal cations exhibit significantly extended spin lifetimes. Applied to time-resolved Faraday rotation data obtained from two perovskite samples, our model extracts key microscopic parameters - including the carrier localization volume and hyperfine correlation time - demonstrating the necessity of the exact dynamical solution over a single-exponential approximation. These findings provide microscopic insight into hyperfine-driven spin relaxation in MHPs and establish a robust framework for characterizing carrier localization and spin dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种精确描述金属卤化物钙钛矿中局域载流子纵向自旋弛豫的模型，解决了传统单指数近似在中等关联时间区间的失效问题，揭示了电子与空穴分别耦合不同原子核的超精细弛豫通道，并预言轻卤素/轻金属阳离子可显著延长自旋寿命。
AI.motivation: 金属卤化物钙钛矿中反转能带结构导致超精细耦合存在异常层级（空穴主导），且实验发现载流子自旋处于中等关联区间，传统单指数近似不再适用，亟需精确理论描述。
AI.method: 将原本用于μ子自旋谱学的自旋弛豫模型适配到钙钛矿体系，在任意超精细关联时间下给出纵向自旋弛豫的精确解，并与时间分辨法拉第旋转实验数据对照拟合。
AI.result: 发现电子主要耦合卤素核、空穴主要耦合金属核的不同弛豫通道；预言轻卤素/轻金属阳离子可显著延长自旋寿命；模型成功从实验数据中提取了载流子局域体积和超精细关联时间等微观参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了描述MHP中超精细驱动自旋弛豫的稳健框架，证明了精确动力学解的必要性，为理解载流子局域化和自旋动力学提供了微观层面的新见解。
